runs.emptyBody: Once you export an agent to CI, every automated review shows up here.
runs.emptyHow: Export an agent to CI, merge the pull request it opens, then open a PR in the target repo — its review will land here.
runs.title: CI Runs
runs.subtitle: Agent reviews executed inside CI · not local runs

exportWizard.title: Export to CI
exportWizard.subtitle: Run {agentName} automatically on pull requests
exportWizard.notAvailableYet: Not available yet — GitHub Actions is the only supported target right now.
exportWizard.repoHint: owner/name — the repo to add the workflow to
exportWizard.replaceWarning: {repo} already runs {agentName} in CI — installing this agent will replace it. A repository can run exactly one DevDigest agent at a time.
exportWizard.replaceConfirm: I understand this replaces the agent currently installed in this repo.
exportWizard.runnerNotPreviewable: This is the bundled runner script (generated, not hand-edited) — its contents aren't shown here.

secretsTable.title: Secrets
secretsTable.openrouterManual: You must add this yourself, in the target repo's Actions secrets — DevDigest cannot see or set it for you.
secretsTable.githubTokenAuto: Provided automatically by GitHub Actions — nothing to add.

exportWizard.blockMergeBody: To block a merge on findings: set "Fail CI on" on this agent's CI tab so the workflow exits non-zero when it finds something, then require the "DevDigest Review" status check in the target repo's own branch protection settings.
exportWizard.installCardTitle: Open a PR with these files
exportWizard.installCardBody: DevDigest opens a PR in {repo} titled “Add DevDigest CI review” with the {count} generated files.
exportWizard.zipCardBody: Download all {count} generated files, including the runner bundle, as a zip archive to add to the repo yourself.
exportWizard.secretNote: Add {key} to the repo's Actions secrets before the workflow runs.

ciTab.heading: CI deployment
ciTab.subtitle: Run this agent automatically on pull requests in a target repo.
ciTab.installedIn: Installed in {count, plural, =0 {0 repositories} one {# repository} other {# repositories}}
ciTab.empty: Not deployed to CI yet. Use “Publish to CI” to open a PR that adds the workflow + agent config.
ciTab.emptyBody: Not deployed to CI yet — use “+ Add to CI” to open a PR that adds the workflow + agent config to a repo.
ciTab.staleNotice: Installed repos keep running the manifest from their last export — re-run the wizard to push a config change.

publishDialog.title: Publish to CI
publishDialog.subtitle: Run {agentName} on every pull request in {repo}
publishDialog.intro: Opens a pull request in {repo} adding a GitHub Actions workflow + this agent's config under .devdigest/. On every PR the agent reviews the diff.
publishDialog.secretNote: Add {key} to the repo's Actions secrets before the workflow runs. GITHUB_TOKEN is provided automatically.
publishDialog.doneBody: Opened/updated a pull request in {repo} with the workflow + agent config.
